formulas.name: fxBody
formulas.expression: "A new lead has been assigned to the intake team for " & {!svar_Intake.litify_pm__Display_Name__c}

formulas.name: fxGetPartyInfo
formulas.expression: "Select Id, litify_pm__First_Name__c, litify_pm__Last_Name__c, litify_pm__Email__c, litify_pm__Phone_Mobile__c, Language__c, Phone_Notes__c FROM Account WHERE Id =" &"'"&{!ExistingParty.recordId}&"'"

formulas.name: fxIsCaseInfo
formulas.expression: IF( OR({!Save_Party_subflow.IsSuccess} = TRUE, {!Create_Party_Subflow.IsSuccess} = TRUE), TRUE, FALSE)

formulas.name: fxPartySOSL
formulas.expression: "FIND {*" & SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE({!Party_Search}, "-", ""), "'", ""), "\"", ""), ":", ""), "&", "") & "*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name, Type, litify_pm__Email__c, litify_pm__Phone_Mobile__c, Phone WHERE Type IN ('Client', 'Potential Client') AND Type != null)"

formulas.name: fxStatus
formulas.expression: IF( AND({!varlivetransferboolean} = TRUE,{!varRecordTypeName}= "Lead"), "In Contact/Under Review", CASE({!varRecordTypeName}, "Lead", "Lead Generated", "Referral", "Referral to be Sent", Null))

formulas.name: fxValidatePartyDetails
formulas.expression: AND( LEN({!First_Name}) >= 2, LEN({!Last_Name}) >= 2, OR( NOT(ISBLANK({!Live_Transfer})), {!Save_Party_subflow.IsSuccess} = TRUE, {!Create_Party_Subflow.IsSuccess} = TRUE ), NOT(ISBLANK({!Phone.value})), OR(ISBLANK({!Email.value}), AND(CONTAINS({!Email.value}, "@"), CONTAINS({!Email.value}, ".")) ) )
